basic_info.description: Rare chance to own a fully vacant multi-family building in the heart of San Francisco's iconic Haight-Ashbury. This beautifully preserved triplex features three distinct units, a spacious 3-car garage, in-unit laundry for all, large dedicated storage rooms for each unit, and timeless architectural charm.  The top-floor flat offers formal living and dining rooms, a remodeled kitchen with island, breakfast nook/office, three bedrooms, two renovated baths (including an en-suite primary), and a private walk-out deck. A bonus attic space with rooftop terrace adds city views and entertaining space.  The middle unit includes two bedrooms, two stylishly updated baths, formal living and dining rooms, a remodeled kitchen with adjacent breakfast area, laundry, and its own storage.  The lower level features a one-bedroom apartment with a refreshed kitchen, updated bath, walk-out patio, laundry, and storage.  All units are move-in readyideal for investors, owner-occupants, or multi-generational living. Near Golden Gate Park and Haight Street shops and cafes.  PageStreetLiving.com
